messages:
maya: Heads up — Stripe has flagged merchant MER-9982 for a suspicious settlement pattern (notified this AM). They put a provisional hold on payouts citing 'suspected_fraud'. Need an evidence packet to contest and a decision on payout hold. Payment IDs in question: pay_3KxA7, pay_3KxB9, pay_3KxC1. Can someone pull full tx logs, BIN/IP mapping, and KYC ASAP?

tom: On it. Do we have the invoice numbers and which refunds already processed? Also want the BIN and IP ranges if available.

maya: Invoice refs: INV-2026-8471, INV-2026-8472. BIN: 457173. IP range observed: 45.76.12.0/24. Quick extract of recent txns below for initial triage: 
```csv
payment_id,amount,currency,created_at,invoice,card_last4,bin,ip,refund
pay_3KxA7,295.00,USD,2026-03-21T02:14:22Z,INV-2026-8471,4242,457173,45.76.12.101,false
pay_3KxB9,295.00,USD,2026-03-21T03:05:10Z,INV-2026-8472,4242,457173,45.76.12.102,true
pay_3KxC1,120.00,USD,2026-03-21T04:33:09Z,INV-2026-8480,1111,457173,45.76.12.103,false
```

finance-bot: stripe.event: payout.failed (evt_1KzN...) reason="suspected_fraud" for merchant MER-9982. Linked payouts: po_5Hk...

liam: Recommend we place a temporary payout hold on MER-9982 until evidence packet is submitted. This prevents further settlement risk. I can set the hold if finance confirms.

sarah: We processed a support-initiated refund for pay_3KxB9 at 2026-03-21T03:08Z (ticket #SUP-4412). Can we pause any other refunds? Also we'll need a customer-facing message template if we escalate.

tom: Pulling AVS/CVV results, device fingerprint, shipping address history, and any previous chargeback flags. I'll compile a PDF evidence bundle for the Stripe dispute portal. ETA ~2 hours.

maya: Thanks. Action items: 1) tom: evidence bundle (tx logs, shipping, KYC, AVS/CVV) 2) liam: apply payout hold 3) sarah: pause refunds and draft comms. Please @legal if you need them on standby. Target: have packet uploaded & hold in place by EOD PST. :eyes:

sarah: Drafting comms now, will post for review in 30m. :thumbsup:

tom: Noted — attaching preliminary export to the thread when ready.

maya: Also logging for audit: reason="high refund velocity + repeated BIN/IP combo". I'll open an internal case and tag fraud ops.

liam: Hold set (provisional) — monitoring payouts. Will revert if Stripe releases.

finance-bot: note: case_created id=CASE-2026-9937 by maya

maya: Closing loop — thanks all. If Stripe requests more, we'll push their dispute deadline window.
